items.title: Live updates: Bitcoin steady as Japan holds rates at 1%, keeping the yen carry trade alive
items.snippet: The Bank of Japan left its benchmark at 1% and Governor Ueda's hawkish signals landed softly, since markets had already priced an October hike. Bitcoin held near $64,000.

items.snippet: BlackRock’s IBIT led $233.1 million in daily inflows as US spot Bitcoin ETFs turned positive for the week and July stayed on track to end in the green.

items.snippet: Samsung and SK Hynix both jumped more than 23%. Bitcoin moved a fraction of a percent in the past 24 hours, and most majors are still lower on the week.

items.title: Major bitcoin wallet flaw drains 594 BTC in 25-minute sweep
items.snippet: A hardware wallet randomness bug turned “impossible to guess” seeds into guessable ones, and $38 million is already gone.

items.title: Crypto’s next altseason may have fewer winners: Wintermute
items.snippet: Institutional investors accounted for 72% of Wintermute’s spot OTC flow in the first half of 2026 as capital clustered in fewer tokens and altcoin rallies became more selective.
